status: frozen before any test-set evaluation; test set not accessed

selected.name: s_learner
selected.training_data: entire training split of the frozen split (no subsampling)
selected.features: f0-f11 only; exposure/visit/conversion/treatment never used as features

selection.rule: Primary metric: AIPW policy value at a 20% contact budget on the fixed validation subset (Qini is a supporting diagnostic only). 1) A model is eligible only if its paired difference from random targeting at 20% has a 95% interval above 0. 2) The best eligible model by point value is found. 3) One-SE simplicity rule: walking from the simplest model (logistic < S-learner < TARNet), the first eligible model whose value is within one paired standard error of the best wins. The paired SE is the bootstrap SE of the difference, taken as the 95% percentile-interval width / 3.92. Hyperparameters are never tuned.

split.fractions: train 64% / validation 16% / test 20%, stratified on treatment

evaluation.estimator_primary: AIPW (IPW reported as a diagnostic only)

nuisance.note: trained on train rows only; the full-train finalists overlap with these rows (about 5.6% of training rows), but validation rows are untouched by both

evaluation.bootstrap: Poisson(1) customer weights from (seed, replicate); paired across policies
evaluation.tie_break: seeded hash of row id (deterministic, independent of row order)
evaluation.qini: 100-point trapezoid, area between gain curve and random line

caveats: Conditional estimates for the released Criteo sample, not population-level effects or ROI.
The constant 0.85 propensity is publisher-supported but unverifiable; IPW and AIPW disagree on this file.
Validation results guided this choice; they are not evidence of final generalization.
